title: Buz – A fork of Bun using modern Zig, with sub-1s incremental builds
summary: Buz is a community-driven fork of the Bun JavaScript runtime and package manager, rewritten in modern Zig to achieve sub-second incremental build times while maintaining API compatibility with Bun.
problem_solved: Provides a fast, open-source alternative to Bun with dramatically faster incremental compilation times using Zig's modern compilation model.
why_valuable: It offers Bun compatibility with sub-1s build times in an open-source project, giving developers a high-performance alternative without vendor lock-in.
